description.narrative: The primary objectives of the Project are to (i) facilitate and act as a catalyst for development in the economically deprived southern region by constructing a new southern highway linking Colombo with Galle, the capital of Southern Province, and Matara; and (ii) produce a sustainable and quantifiable reduction in the country's very high road accident rate. The secondary objective is poverty reduction within the immediate project area, where more than 30% of the population is classified as poor, and within the south of the country generally.

Reduction in fatal accident rate on A2 from 360 per 1 million vehicles by 10% in the first year operation of highway and 50 % by 2013 Progress/Status: will be assessed during project completion review. Road Safety Consultant started the assignment in February 2003. The Expressway safety has been analyzed in general and it has been concluded that strong law enforcement, publicity campaigns and driver education are the key issues irrespective of the choice of cross sectional features. Efficient emergency services will be an important mitigation factor. Higher speeds will inevitably lead to more serious accidents. Black spot improvement programs have been started, and are almost complete. Road Safety consultancy funded by SIDA was completed in 31 December 2005, and final report submitted.
Based on the study, road safety black spots improvement have been done at various intersections, and this work is also almost completed. Data Source: RDA (planning division) annual reports Base year: 1999 Baseline value: n
